batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Shubman Gill b SP Narine

batting.name: Q de Kock
batting.dismissal: c SP Narine b M Prasidh Krishna

batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b M Prasidh Krishna

batting.name: Ishan Kishan
batting.dismissal: c AD Russell b LH Ferguson

batting.name: KH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c VR Iyer b LH Ferguson

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: c TA Boult b JJ Bumrah

balls.text: full on off. Drilled straight down the ground and he hits this slot ball for four. Mumbai finish on 155 for 6
slower ball, almost a yorker outside off. Backs away and bunts a shot to point for one
full on middle and leg. Whipped off his pads to Tripathi at deep midwicket. Team 150

on a team hat-trick as Lockie makes that two in two. Back of a length ball from around the stumps. Takes the pace off too. Pandya looks to pull by swiveling to the leg side, but that's been mistimed. Iyer at long on gets under it

Pollard caught napping at the bowler's end! Full and wide ball, Pollard clatters a shot to Morgan at cover. But Morgan picks up in one swift move, and then throws to Ferguson with the bowler near the stumps. Pollard slow off the blocks, and out by a couple of metres
yorker attempted, dipping just outside off. Pollard backs away to make room but can't do anything about that top delivery. Dug back to Ferguson
quicker ball to end the over. Back of a length on off and angling away. Looks to slap a cut over point but no connection. Ten off the over
dipping yorker around his toes on leg stump. Ends up as a full toss near his toes, and flicked to deep midwicket
dance moves are out here! Yorker length just outside leg stump. Pollard spreads his legs, making space for the ball to go through. Legal ball even though its down the leg side
full just outside off. Goes down the ground with a drive. But two fielders at long on and long off though
not short enough. Middle stump line, pace taken off. Pandya pulls to the leg side!
fullish ball on middle. Mistimed slog to wide long on for a couple
terrific ball. Good length just outside off and jags in sharply. Goes just under the bat as Pollard was trying to nudge it to third man. Through to DK. Eighteen off the over
wide yorker, but just beyond the tramlines. Good intentions, execution just a bit off. Pollard leaves
full and wider outside off stump. Reaches out to drive but misses. Wide given. 17 off the over so far...
back of a length, outside leg. Looks to pull, but it hits his glove. DK dives to his right to catch, but can't hold on. Rolls away for more runs
taken at long on but he's not out since its a free hit. Good length, outside off, and he mistimes the flat-batted shot to the fielder straight down
full and wide outside off stump. Strong drive to wide long off, and a comfortable two for Pollard. But the sirens go off again - Krishna has overstepped for the second time today.
streaky! Good length outside off. Tries to pull through to the leg side, but bottom-edged to fine leg for four more!
premeditated from Pollard. He opened his stance even before Prasidh released the ball. Took the front leg beyond leg stump, and then pulls this short ball from outside off over deep midwicket
good length, on middle stump. Tapped from near the stump to point's right
full just outside off. Caresses a drive to mid off, and scampers across for one. Two runs and a wicket
around the stumps. Good length outside off. Punched, but finds cover
back of a length outside off but angling in sharply into his hips. Turned off his waist to midwicket for one
good length on off stump, and angling in. Nudged off his hips to midwicket

skyer and Russell runs in from long on to take a catch around mid on. Short ball, on middle, and Kishan looks to pull. But he toe-ends the shot, and Russell makes no mistake although it went high in the night sky
slower ball yorker just outside off stump. Dips late, under the bat, through to the keeper
slower ball, width offered with this short delivery. Cut in front of square where deep extra cover - Iyer - runs around to intercept
back of a length, on off stump. Quick to duck under it

full on middle stump. Searches for the yorker but ends up in the slot. Flicked to deep midwicket, where Lockie has to dive and stop the four. They'll check whether that's four or two. It's four: the ball burst through Lockie's hands
back of a length, on leg stump. Another slower ball. Pulled along the ground to deep backward square leg
back of a length, cutter too. Lands around leg, and he nudges it with soft hands to the leg side
short ball, on leg stump, Kishan comfortably pulls this to fine leg with full intention. Rolls his wrists over the shot to get the elevation and direction
fullish just outside off. Pollard leans forward to defend it back to Krishna. Bowler fields on the followthrough, and he has a staredown with Pollard.

mistimed! Slower ball, full just outside off. de Kock picks the slower ball, and then tries to clatter a slog over midwicket. But the bat's face turned while playing the shot, and it's gone straight to Narine at midwicket. Out for 55
good length ball on middle. Angling away. de Kock looks to pull but is nowhere near the line. Through to DK
full and wide outside off. Forcing de Kock to reach at it. He can't, but unfortunately for Krishna that's gone over the wide-line. Has to rebowl the free-hit
back of a length, outside leg stump. Looks to pull behind square, hits the glove and rolls away square. Takes one, but Krishna won't be happy with himself since that's a front-foot no ball
full and wide outside off. Slower ball from Krishna. de Kock moves to the off side and clatters a drive through to extra cover in the deep
back of a length on middle. Angling towards off. Mistimes a grounded pull to midwicket
full on middle stump, and driven to mid off. Quick single from Kishan
smacked off the back foot, and lifted over midwicket for four. Good length ball angling into his body. Stays deep, and pulls it to the leg side. Team hundred as well
back of a length, on leg stump. Softly tapped to the gap at midwicket for a single. Lockie has to give the ball a chase himself
yorker attempted. On off. Dug away to mid off, scurries across for one and that's his 50!
good length, outside off. Flat-bats a mistimed shot to mid off
good length, on middle. And nudged down to third man for a single
slower ball yorker attempted. Just outside leg stump, around his heels. Flicked to deep backward square leg
good length, outside leg stump. Clipped off his pads to deep backward square leg for one
back of a length, on middle. Rides the bounce and nudges it down to third man for a single
good length, outside off. Uses the width to slap a cut to deep point. Fielder at deep extra cover runs around to cut it off. That's 26 balls without a boundary
good length on middle, and he presses forward to fend a ball towards cover
fullish, on off stump. Angling across slightly. Left alone

out first ball! Good length just outside off. Surya looks to flick across the line, and ends up getting an edge to DK. Just a bit of away movement after hitting the deck, and that's what messes Surya's attempted flick. Expected the ball would angle in, instead it went the other direction. Surya's dry run continues
full on middle. And he muscles a sloggy shot to deep midwicket. Narine finishes with 1/20
good length on middle. Turning into leg. Nudged off his pads to Russell at short fine leg
slower through the air. Length ball angling into leg stump. Misses the flick. Hits the pad. Impact way outside leg stump of course
good length on middle, from around the stumps. Sliding into the left-hander's leg side. Mistimed reverse sweep to cover point. Premeditated, perhaps.
full on leg stump. Turning in further. Looks to flick behind square, but it hits the pad and rolls away to the left of short fine leg
full ball just outside off. He steps across and looks to sweep. Mistimed to short fine leg after exposing two stumps
wicketless day for Varun. Good length on middle, and skidding into leg. Worked off the back foot to midwicket for one
full on middle, and nudged off the front foot to midwicket once again
full on off stump. Mistimed flick from off stump to deep midwicket
full on middle. Turning towards off. Whipped off his toes to deep midwicket for just one.
chipped over cover with long off running to his left to cut it off. Full outside off, and comfortably played
good length, on leg stump. Whipped off his waist to deep midwicket
fullish outside off, and de Kock dabs it toward short third man
good length delivery on middle, and clipped to deep midwicket
very full on off, and he drives but gets that off the outside edge to point
beaten first ball! Goes to cut this shorish and wide ball outside off, but doesn't get bat on ball

goes for the heave, but is taken at long-on! Narine gets Rohit yet again - ninth time in T20s. It is a good length ball on off, which gets good bounce. Rohit is down on his back knee early to try and hammer that, but gets it off the higher side of the bat, as the catch is taken right on the edge of the boundary
slogged to long leg on the bounce. Full ball on middle and leg, and he swings that forcefully to the on side
full delivery on off, and angling in. Clipped to deep midwicket, as Mumbai round off another productive over
full and pitches wide of leg. Rohit goes for the flick, but doesn't get bat, and it is called wide
pretty full and wide of off. de Kock stretches out for that, and drags it to long-off
good length delivery on off, and dabbed toward cover for a single
much fuller and just wide of off. de Kock looks to slash, but he gets an inside edge to fine leg

almost takes Rohit down there! Full delivery in the slot on off, and de Kock hangs back deep in his crease and clears his front leg to loft that just over his captain, who has to duck for life. Four more
creamed through extra cover! Just stands deep to this good length ball outside off, and he drives commandingly to bisect mid-off and the man at extra cover
good length delivery just outside off, and driven firmly too, but right to the man at cover
short of a length again, but Rohit gets an inside edge off his pull
just short of long-on running forward! Short in length on middle, and de Kock pulls, but survives
chipped back to the bowler, as this fullish ball on middle turns away from him. de Kock's head was almost falling over there
good length ball a touch wide of off. Cut late to deep point
full ball outside off, with a hint of turn away from the batter. Flicked from deep in his crease to deep midwicket
another full ball on his pads. de Kock simply runs that down to deep midwicket to keep rotating the strike
sweeps this full delivery on off to deep fine leg after going down on his back knee
beats his outside edge! Full and quick outside off at 95kph. Rohit tries to have a poke, but the ball passes his bat
full delivery outside off again, and that is pushed back to the bowler
full delivery on the leg side, and that is flicked behind to short fine leg. de Kock looks at Rohit if he is ready for the run, and yes says his captain
very full ball just outside off, dabbed late toward short third man
full-toss on his pads, as de Kock clips to deep square leg. The man at fine leg has to run to his right to slide and stop that
hoicked over deep square leg for six more! Another delivery in the slot on middle, and de Kock uses his bottom hand to swing that away for the maximum. Effortless hit
wide delivery now. On a good length, but pitches outside leg, as de Kock looks to pull from within the crease. Wide called
and again change of pace. This time at 103kph. On a good length on middle and leg, as de Kock clips to square leg
hammered over the bowler's head! Another change of pace ball, but this is right in the slot on off stump, as de Kock clears his front leg to dispatch that way into the stands
de Kock slips, and survives a run-out! He dives back, as the throw from square leg misses the stumps. Slower ball on a full length on pads, and de Kock immediately took off after clipping that
full delivery on off, and Rohit clips to midwicket

tonked over fine leg with class! Short of a length ball on middle, and climbing onto him too. de Kock waits for it to come, and pulls with a swivel. Uses the pace of the bowler to play from deep in his crease, as the ball lands far behind

strokes his front pad, as Rohit goes to flick this fullish ball on middle, which is also angling in. More pace from Lockie, at 147kph, as the batters sneak a leg-bye with the ball rolling over to the off side
pretty full on middle and off, and flicked to deep square leg. The man on the fence runs to his left to stop that
good length ball again, but just outside off. That was at 143kph, as de Kock's heave to the on side comes off the inside half of the bat to deep square leg
goes across to try and ramp that good length ball outside off behind the wicket but gets an inside edge to his back pad. The bowler followed him as went across
fullish in length on off, and turned to deep square leg with the closed face of the bat
pulls his length back a touch on leg, and bowls at 102kph. Another reverse from de Kock finds the point fielder
another reverse-sweep, but this ball is full and on leg. Dragged toward point
full ball on off, and clipped to deep midwicket. de Kock wanted a second, but is sent back
fullish on off, and pushed to cover
steps across and sweeps to fine leg now! Both fine leg and square leg are inside the circle, as Rohit goes down on his back knee to sweep the full ball outside off, which is turning into him
lofted over mid-off for four more! The bat turns in his hands, as Rohit lifts this full ball on off, which is spinning into him

reverse-swept between short third man and point! Chakravarthy at short third man flies to his left, but to no avail. The ball was full on off, and de Kock went down early into his shot. Nice timing and placement
turns back into him off a good length outside off. Pushed to cover
much fuller, and close to his pads. Flicked to deep square leg for another single
shorter in length on off, and pulled to deep midwicket! Plays it with the turn into him, and there are acres of space of available there
full in length on middle, with a hint of turn into him. Clipped to the man close in at midwicket, as they scamper for the run, with the throw arriving at the keeper's end
turns into him off a full length on middle, as Rohit clips toward deep square
short of a length on off, and again Rohit simply runs that down to long-on
much fuller on middle, and flicked to deep midwicket, with the man inside the circle at midwicket giving it a go to his right in vain
full on middle, and it straightened after pitching. Leading edge off his clip, but safe and back to the bowler
shorter in length on middle, as Rohit punches that down to deep midwicket
full again, but wide of leg. Keeps slanting down, and is wide
fuller on off, and clipped with the closed face of the bat to square leg
full ball and a touch wide of off. Seemed like spinning into him, as Rohit drove to cover
full and tight on off, pushed forward to mid-off
this is again full and straight on off, but it is driven down to long-on
makes room to this full ball outside off, but finds the man at cover with his drive
full and straighter on off, pushed to the right of the bowler, and close to the non-striker
fuller on off, and tapped toward cover with the open face of the bat
beats mid-off first ball! Fullish in length outside off, and he presents the full face of the bat to caress it to mid-off's left for four
reverse sweep Full outside off, and smacked past short third man for four! Knight Riders win by 7 wickets
full ball on off, and a beautiful drive down the ground to tie the scores.
good length on leg stump. Angling across. Nurdles a shot past the diving slip fielder for a single
yorker attempted. Lands in front of off. Dug away to long on for a single
good length ball angling into his hips. Just whips it off his waist, and fine leg is totally vacant. Tripathi moves into his seventies, KKR need five more
good length ball angling into the stumps. Backs away and taps it to point. No run though
back of a length, on middle, and he pulls to the leg side. But top-edged, and it goes to Boult fielding in the deep.
good length, outside off and angling in. Mistimes a pull, ball rolls away to midwicket
full just outside off stump. Clatters a drive to cover
back of a length, outside leg stump. Pulled along the ground to Krunal at deep square leg
good length, outside off. Cut to backward point with the ball angling away
back of a length outside leg. Morgan walks down the track to slap a shot through the covers. But toe-ended back to Milne
good length, just outside off. Bends his knees and runs it down to third man
going, going, gone! Half-tracker on middle. He goes deep in his crease and pulls it over deep midwicket for six. KKR eke out 17 from the over
full on middle. Turning into leg. Defended off the front foot
good length, just outside off stump. Pulled off the back foot to deep midwicket. Nearly went all the way!

edged past the keeper! Full outside off, and turning away. Tripathi stretches out to drive, but it takes the edge, no slip there, and even past Kishan at short third man. But he gives the ball a chase and slides near the boundary to stop the four. But his leg is touching the boundary in the attempt: four more.
tossed up, nicely flighted. Full outside off and turning away. Tries another slog sweep, but misses out. Could've been stumped there
massive! Picks the googly well, and drags a slog sweep over deep midwicket for six. Full just outside off and turning in. Tripathi puts it away
good length, outside leg stump. Tries to defend off the back foot, but plays with hard hands. Ball very nearly pops back for Bumrah to take a catch!
length ball outside leg and angling into his body. Hits his body as he misses the cut

leg stump knocked back and Iyer has been done in by a slower ball. Fullish, outside leg stump but angling into leg. He clears the front leg to muscle a six over midwicket but this time he is done in by the lack of pace. Standing ovation for Iyer from the KKR management
full on off stump. Slices a drive, over the infield. Milne's in the deep though
length ball angling into his body. Muscles a sloggy shot through the midwicket-mid on gap, and that rolls away for four more!

the luck! Yorker length outside off. Tripathi shuffles across to paddle it over fine leg but a leading edge takes it to the third-man direction. Krunal in the deep stretches an arm out to take a catch, but the ball goes over his head to hit the boundary skirting on the full! Should've been out, could've been four, ends up as a six. Fifty for Tripathi!
full just outside leg. Clears the front leg, and that allows him to flick it behind square, past square leg, to the fielder in the deep

in the air as he goes for a lofted shot off the full ball. Sliced in the air, goes over Chahar, and the bowler runs in the direction of the ball for a catch. But it falls just beyond him! All the luck going KKR's way tonight
fullish, just outside leg stump. Pushed off the back foot to long on for a single.
good length outside leg. Iyer steps back, exposing all three stumps, and then clatters a mistimed cut to cover. Bit of a yes-no-yes-no
full, just outside leg stump. Turning into leg. Nudged to the on side
good length, just outside off. Doesn't turn. Cut from near off stump to backward point in the deep. Fielder has to run around to intercept
dabs this good length ball on off to third man
bouncer, and five wides! Too short in length on leg, and there is extra bounce too, as Iyer goes for the pull, but the ball flies over him and de Kock
this skids on and comes back in from a good length on middle. Pushed toward midwicket
he gets the width, and beats deep point to his left! Short of a length and wide of off, and cut away from his body for another four, as this one was a slower ball too
slashed just short of deep point! His bottom hand comes off as he looks to loft that slower ball on a fullish length outside off. Chahar dives forward, but the ball is still short
full ball on off, and angling in. Opens the bat face to tap that to ppoint
full and outside leg, as Iyer makes room and skips down to hoick that to long-on off the inside half of the bat
sweeps between long-on and deep midwicket! And Knight Riders just keep piling up runs for fun. Full delivery on middle and off, and he is down on his knee to slog that for another boundary
another very full ball on middle, as Iyer dances down and drives to long-off
yorker length on middle. Iyer jams that back to his pad off the inside edge
on a good length on middle, and he turns that toward midwicket
full on middle, and quicker too. Pushed to the man at cover
shimmies down, and clears long-on! Another whack, and another six. Full ball on middle, and he gives himself room to heave that away
full delivery on middle, and he closes the bat face to clip that to the man at midwicket
tickles that to to beat Bumrah at short third man. Full and outside off, as he just dabs at that late to pocket four more
good length ball on leg, and clipped to deep square with a little turn away from the batter
fetches this from outside off, and sweeps to deep midwicket! Very full outside off, and he is down on his knee to slog that and beat Boult to his left
cuts this short delivery outside off to point, as this one just turns away a little
googly first up. On a short of a length on middle, and pulled to deep midwicket with the turn
good length on middle, as he clips that to deep square while playing with a bit of room. Another expensive over for Mumbai, as Knight Riders rake up more
very full just outside off, and drilled to long-off with a slight Dhoni helicopter touch
goes to sweep this full ball, but it pitched on leg, and the ball rolls over to short fine off his front pad
pulls his length back to on a good length on middle and leg, as Iyer punches that down to long-on
just about clears deep midwicket! Comes down to this full delivery on middle and leg, and swung that away cleanly for six
short in length and just outside off, with a hint of turn away. Cut away to deep point
slower ball on a good length outside off. The ball hints to come back in, as he opens the bat face to run that to third man
finds the gap between deep square and deep midwicket. Again he makes room and dances down, as Milne bowls on a good length outside leg, with Iyer pulling that away with not great timing
goes inside out over cover, as mid-off gives the chase. Very full ball on off, as he looks to loft that after clearing his front leg and remaining deep in his crease
some cat-and-mouse stuff going on here. Iyer makes room to go way outside leg, and the bowler follows him to go on a good length even further outside leg
upper cuts this short of a length ball on middle and off to third man, while swaying away a touch
steps across, and ramps that over short fine leg! Good length ball just outside off, but he is already way across to comfortably scoop that for four more
skips down and lofts over mid-off! The bat face opens as he tries to lift that full delivery on leg, and uses his wrists
goes for the reverse, but is beaten. That was full and outside off, and Iyer was into his shot early there
good length delivery outside off, and cut away to the man at cover
full delivery again on off, and this time he finds the gap to drive it to long-off
fuller ball on off, with a hint of turn away. Driven to cover with a horizontal bat
slower on a good length on middle. Gets an inside edge as he looks to push at that
good length ball on middle, and skids along. Pushed to the left of long-off for a quick two
change of pace to go full o middle. Driven to the right of mid-on after waiting for the ball to come
slashed to beat third man to his right! Looked like that came off the outside edge as went to cut that, as it was a short and wide ball outside off
slower ball, and very full outside leg. Angles away a touch, as he misses his flick. Half an appeal for leg before by Boult, but that was always sliding down leg
good length ball on middle and off, and pulled to the man at midwicket, where the fielder dives to his right to keep that to a dot
backs away outside leg, and Boult follows him with a good length ball on leg, that angles in. Iyer eventually pushes it to mid-off
pulled on the bounce to deep square! Another short delivery from Boult, which pitches on off, as Iyer pulls again. Deep square runs forward to stop that

bowled 'im! Bumrah hits back! Offcutter from the quick this time, as Gill chops it back on to his stumps. He looks to poke at that tentatively, as it is a full delivery pitching on off, while also coming back in. There is a gap between his bat and pad, and enough space for the ball to crash into his middle stump
good length delivery on middle, which is angling away. Dabs this to short third man, and takes off right away. The throw arrives at the bowler's end, but doesn't hit the stumps
driven down the ground between the non-striker and mid-off! Bumrah bowls very full on off - perhaps in search of the yorker - but Iyer drills it back for another four
another good length ball outside off, which is angling in. Gill dabs that toward the keeper, and they set off for a single
tighter line this time. Good length delivery just outside off, as Gill taps that to cover while staying leg side of the ball
very full outside leg, and clipped behind! Just a tickle, and he finds the gap between the keeper and short fine leg, as the ball trickles into the fence for another four. Phew, this is some start!

outside edge, and four more! Another 15-run over for Knight Riders. This is a rollicking start by the openers. It is a full delivery outside off, and Iyer throws his bat at that to slog it, but gets an edge, with the ball running away to third man
pretty full ball on middle, and clipped to the man at midwicket
a chip, and four! That was aerially hit, but in the gap. Good length ball outside off, and he finds the gap between cover-point and cover for four
swung away over short fine leg! Another short of a length ball on middle, and angling into the batter, who swivels with a pull to dispatch that for another maximum full stretch
slower ball on a good length ball on off. Pulled to deep square after the ball seemed to have come into him after pitching
good length ball just outside off, and angling in a touch. Blocked off the back foot and back to the bowler
makes room, dances down and slices this full ball on middle and leg over point for a couple more. Third man runs to his left to cut that off
good length ball outside off, and straightening too. Dabbed toward cover slightly away from his body
pulled from close to his body, and that is again over deep square! Short of a length on off, and Iyer pulls from deep in his crease, and off the front foot
full delivery again on middle and leg, with a hint of movement into him. Clipped to fine leg
walks down, and simply whacks that with disdain! Uses his bottom hand to flick that full ball outside off to deposit that way over deep square leg
pretty full and wide of off. Gill lets that go, as if thinking it was a wide, which it is not given to leave him surprised
